job: Make project tax treatment an explicit, hash-bound planning input: excluded at the default 0%, or a user-stated allowance that is visibly not tax advice and invalidates RFQs and quotes when changed.

outputs.acceptance: Every current budget scenario contains a bounded salesTaxPct. Zero means excluded; a non-zero value is labelled as a user-stated planning allowance, not a jurisdictional rate or tax advice. Legacy scenarios without the field read as zero.
The budget exposes a separate tax range computed from subtotal plus contingency, and the total, visible assumptions and exclusions reconcile exactly.
RFQs and quote receipts preserve the tax assumption through their budget basis; changing it changes the budget hash and produces a named tax-basis invalidation reason.

The budget UI makes exclusion and the user-stated percentage clear, persists the value, survives reload, and explains that a qualified professional must confirm the actual taxable base, rebates and treatment.

dependsOn.evidence: ProjectBudget already binds the design, site, region, utilities, delivery, finish, shipping and contingency basis.
Version-two RFQs and quotes already carry the budget basis and explain named input changes.

rejectionGates: Reject if any landing-scene, Three.js, animation, model, meadow, tree, sky, mountain, shader, camera, lighting, builder plan geometry, GLB or generated-plan asset changes.
Reject if Aura supplies, recommends or implies a statutory tax rate, taxable base, rebate, exemption, input-credit treatment or professional tax conclusion.
Reject if a non-zero allowance is hidden inside another line, if zero is not visibly described as excluded, or if property tax is treated as project sales tax.
Reject if changing only salesTaxPct leaves the budget hash, RFQ/quote basis state or named change explanation unchanged.
Reject if a legacy scenario without salesTaxPct becomes unreadable or silently receives a non-zero amount.
Reject if the tax calculation cannot be reconciled from subtotal, contingency and the user-stated percentage, or if invalid and non-finite inputs escape deterministic bounds.
Reject if any external tax, legal, payment, HOMES, deployment, outreach, provider or jurisdiction gate is crossed.

verify.freshContextVerifier: A verifier that did not implement BQ03 must inspect the final stable snapshot when delegation is authorized.
commands: cd app && npx playwright test tests/project-budget.spec.ts tests/project-document.spec.ts tests/project-discovery-rfq.spec.ts tests/quote-reconciliation.spec.ts --workers=1
cd app && npx playwright test tests/budget-ui.spec.ts --config=playwright.ui.config.ts --workers=1
anchors: At 0%, tax.low, tax.mid and tax.high are zero and visible copy says the allowance is excluded.
At a user-stated percentage, tax equals that percentage of subtotal plus contingency for every range bound and totals reconcile.
A scenario saved without salesTaxPct reloads and normalizes to 0%, while a custom value persists unchanged.
Changing only salesTaxPct produces a different budget hash and a tax basisChanges entry in both RFQ and quote reconciliation.
No changed path is under the frozen 3D, animation, model, meadow, worker or plan-geometry sets.

repair.scope: Only BQ03 tax-basis normalization, calculation, persistence, invalidation, UI disclosure or focused test integration may be repaired. A second failure returns the node to blocked without touching any frozen visual path.
